status: Unapproved screen-colour candidates only; no thread selection or artwork recolouring applied.
scope: Printful standard embroidery palette. Confirm actual account/product options in Design Maker.

method.name: CIELAB D65 Delta E 1976
method.description: Published sRGB hexes linearized with standard sRGB companding, transformed to XYZ D65 and CIELAB, then ranked by Euclidean Lab distance. This compares screen swatches, not measured physical threads.
method.rankingCoverage: All 15 published standard-palette swatches; top two retained for each target.
method.limitations: No measured thread spectra, substrate, sheen, lighting or sew-out data. These distances are not colour tolerances or approval evidence. No exact standard-palette hex match exists.

applicationRules: Keep original brand hexes in uploaded PNGs; review Printful's automatic mapping explicitly.
Light artwork has Ink main forms and Rust punctuation or clock accent; dark artwork has Bone main forms and Sun accent.
The Caramel cap and Espresso crewneck are Bone-only, including their punctuation.
Back DTG uses the artwork colours and has no embroidery thread mapping.
Do not infer exact physical matching or account availability from a public Unlimited-colour option.
